answer_1.quote: For open-domain QA where a system is required to provide an exact answer string a, the retrieved top k passages P k are subsequently fed into a reading comprehension model such as a BERT model , and this is called the retriever-reader approach .

answer_2.quote: We measure the top-k passage retrieval accuracy (Top-k), which denotes the proportion of questions whose top k retrieved passages contain at least one of the gold answers. To further characterize the behavior of each system, we also include the following evaluation metrics: mean reciprocal rank at k (MRR@k) and precision at k (P@k).
